text: Nityasambandha is Samavaya, Ayutasiddhavrittih (a property that exists in a pair). When two things depend on each other, then it is Ayutasiddha. Avayava-avayavinau (parts and whole), gunaguninau (qualities and qualities), kriyakriyavantau (actions and actions), jati vyakti visheshana nityadravye cheti (in species, individuals, attributes, and permanent substances). || 68 ||
